questions.question:
[SABAS]
A simple sentence has -[]
options: Only one subject and many verbs.
Only one subject and one finite verb.
Only one subject and two verbs.

questions.question:
[SABAS]
A simple sentence consists of-[]

[SABAS]
What is a simple sentence?[]

[SABAS]
Simple sentence-[]
options: I saw that he was reading.
I saw him when he was reading.
I saw a man who was lame.

questions.question:
[SABAS]
Which of the following sentences is a simple sentence?[]
options: In spite of his poverty he is happy
I know that he is rich
I respect him as he loves me

questions.question:
[SABAS]
A complex sentence has -[]
options: One principal/main clause and one or more subordinate clauses
One subject and more subordinate clauses
One principal verb and one clause

questions.question:
[SABAS]
When I was reading a book, he came. It is a -[]

[SABAS]
'I know what his name is' is a - sentence.[]

[SABAS]
Though, although, because, since, as' implies the type of sentence:[]

[SABAS]
Which is the correct simple sentence?[]
options: The fog being dispersed, the sun rose.
The sun rose and the fog dispersed.
When the sun rose, the fog dispersed.
The sun having risen, the fog dispersed.

questions.question: Although he is rich, he is an honest man. This is a – [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Although' দ্বারা গঠিত clause-টি subordinate clause, তাই এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: What kind of sentence is – “Fight till you die”? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: till' বা 'until' যুক্ত হয়ে subordinate clause গঠন করলে তা Complex sentence হয়.

questions.question: If it rains, the match will be postponed. The type of sentence is- [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: If' যুক্ত conditional বাক্যটি একটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: There is no mother but loves her child.
He tried hard to help me.
questions.explanation: এখানে 'but' relative pronoun হিসেবে কাজ করায় এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: There is no mother but loves her children. The sentence is - [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এই বাক্যে 'but' একটি relative pronoun হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে, যা subordinate clause গঠন করে.

questions.question: Which one of the following is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: He is better than any other boy in the class.
We eat that we may live.
We saw him writing a letter.
questions.explanation: that' conjunction ব্যবহার করে subordinate clause গঠন করা হয়েছে, তাই এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Do whatever you like. This is an example of - [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: whatever' দ্বারা subordinate clause গঠন করা হয়েছে, তাই এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Which one of the followings is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Some students like to study in the morning.
I hate running, but like walking.
They are studying because they have a test in the afternoon.
Too many cooks spoil the broth.
questions.explanation: because' conjunction যুক্ত হয়ে subordinate clause গঠন করায় এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Despite his poverty, he is honest.
Having reached in London, he will attend a conference
The man who came here this morning is my brother.
questions.explanation: who' দ্বারা গঠিত clause-টি subordinate clause, তাই এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Though Rajib is ill, he regularly attends classes.
Despite his illness, he regularly attends classes.
Inspite his illness, he regularly attends classes.
Rajib is ill, but regularly attends classes.
questions.explanation: Though' যুক্ত হয়ে subordinate clause গঠন করায় এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: A compound sentence has --- [SABAS][]
options: A subject and a finite verb
One principal clause and one sub-ordinate clause
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ দুই বা ততোধিক Principal clause থাকে, যা Co-ordinating conjunction দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়।

questions.question: A compound sentence must have --- principal clause. [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এর মৌলিক বৈশিষ্ট্য হলো এতে অন্তত দুটি Principal clause থাকতে হয়।

questions.question: Identify the compound sentence: [SABAS][]
options: If you read you will learn
Turning to the left you will see the shop
I shall work or I shall fail
Had I the wings of a bird
questions.explanation: I shall work' এবং 'I shall fail' দুটি Principal clause 'or' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে।

questions.question: ‘Do or die’ is a – [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এখানে দুটি Imperative clause 'or' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়ে Compound sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: Which one is a compound sentence? [SABAS][]
options: As I am weak I cannot walk.
Owing to weakness I cannot walk.
I am weak but I can walk.
I can walk although I am weak.
questions.explanation: এখানে 'I am weak' ও 'I can walk' দুটি Principal clause 'but' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে।

questions.question: We must not be late, else we will miss the train.' This is a- [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: else' দ্বারা দুটি Principal clause যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি Compound sentence।

questions.question: Which of the following is a simple sentence? [SABAS][]
options: He is weak but is a hard worker.
In spite of being weak, he works hard.
He is weak but hard worker.
Though he is weak, he works hard.
questions.explanation: In spite of being weak' একটি phrase এবং একটি Finite verb থাকায় এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: Which of the following is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Let them do or they will die.
If he helps us we will win.
Work hard or you can't prosper in life.
questions.explanation: If' দ্বারা subordinate clause গঠিত হওয়ায় এটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: ‘Do or die’ is a/an – sentence. [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এটি একটি Compound sentence, যেখানে দুটি Imperative clause 'or' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে।

questions.question: What type of sentence ‘Work or you will fail’ is? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: or' conjunction ব্যবহার করে দুটি স্বাধীন বাক্য যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি Compound sentence।

questions.question: Jumping up he ran away' This sentence is – [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Jumping up' একটি participle phrase এবং বাক্যে একটিমাত্র finite verb (ran) থাকায় এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: All the following sentences are compound except- [SABAS][]
options: He was ill, therefore, he could not come.
Speak the truth and I shall pardon you.
He must return the goods or pay the bill.
I offended him as did this.
questions.explanation: I offended him as did this' বাক্যটিতে একটি principal clause ও একটি subordinate clause থাকায় এটি Complex sentence, Compound নয়।

questions.question: Learn English and get a good job. It is a/an -- [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: দুটি imperative clause 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি একটি Compound sentence।

questions.question: ‘There is nothing nobler than love’ is a/an- [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এটিতে 'than' conjunction-এর ব্যবহার পরোক্ষভাবে একটি subordinate clause নির্দেশ করে, তাই এটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: If you read, you will learn. This sentence is a – [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: If' যুক্ত conditional বাক্য সর্বদা Complex sentence হয়।

questions.question: ‘One day the sailors saw an albatross flying towards the ship’. It is an example of a- [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: বাক্যটিতে একটিমাত্র subject এবং একটিমাত্র finite verb (saw) থাকায় এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: Identify the complex sentence. [SABAS][]
options: He finished his exercise and put away his books.
He bought the library which belonged to his uncle.
questions.explanation: which belonged to his uncle' একটি adjective clause (subordinate), তাই এটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: ‘A hundred percent marks in English is too high to achieve.’ is a – sentence. [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র clause এবং finite verb (is) থাকায় এটি একটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: ‘He had many acquaintances but few really close friends. This is the example of- [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: but' দ্বারা যুক্ত দুটি অংশ একটি Compound sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: This is the act of a wise man.
This is an act and a wise man does it.
This act is done by a wise man.
This is the act that a wise man does.
questions.explanation: that a wise man does' অংশটি adjective clause, যা complex sentence গঠন করে।

questions.question: ‘I know who he is.’ This is an example of —. [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: who he is' একটি noun clause, যা principal clause-এর object হিসেবে কাজ করছে, তাই এটি complex sentence।

questions.question: All that glitters is not gold. This sentence is – [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: that glitters' একটি subordinate adjective clause, তাই এটি complex sentence।

questions.question: Which one is a compound sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Seeing the police the thief ran away
The thief saw the police while he ran away
When the thief saw the police, he ran away
The thief saw the police and ran away
questions.explanation: দুটি প্রধান খণ্ডবাক্য (The thief saw the police ও ran away) 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে, তাই এটি compound।

questions.question: The South Pole is too cold for human beings to live in. It is a : [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র finite verb (is) এবং একটি clause থাকায় এটি simple sentence।

questions.question: Which is a simple sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Tell me what you mean by this.
He always does not speak as he thinks.
If I make a promise, I keep it.
The machine is working beyond our expectation.
questions.explanation: এতে কোনো subordinate clause নেই এবং একটিমাত্র finite verb (is working) রয়েছে, তাই এটি simple sentence।

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: The water being very hot, I couldn't drink
Since the water was very hot, I couldn't drink it.
Being poor, I couldn't buy a chain
Because of his playing well, he won the game
questions.explanation: Since' যুক্ত অংশটি একটি subordinate clause, যা complex sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: ‘Though he was very rich, he was still very unhappy’ is a — [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Though' যুক্ত খণ্ডবাক্যটি subordinate, যা complex sentence নির্দেশ করে।

questions.question: He looked all around and disappeared. The type of this sentence is — [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: দুটি সমজাতীয় অংশ (looked, disappeared) 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়ে compound sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: The sentence “He ate rice and came to school” is — [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এতে দুটি সমজাতীয় খণ্ডবাক্য 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়ে compound sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: “She spoke very strongly and you listened to her.” It is an example of--- [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: দুটি স্বাধীন বাক্য (principal clauses) 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি Compound sentence।
